description:
• About our brand and products: The FEMME LA heel is not an afterthought. It's the decision the whole outfit is built around. From the barely-there, ANDX Sandal, to the spiked Donatella Mule, every style in our collection is designed in Los Angeles with one intention: to make you unforgettable. Handmade, cruelty-free, and built for the woman who refuses to compromise on ethics or aesthetics. All starting at $199.


• What makes us different: We're not chasing trends — we're setting the outfit's whole intention. No filler collections, no compromise on craftsmanship. If your audience already stops scrolling for a great pair of heels, they'll stop for these.


• How affiliates can earn: 20% commission on every sale you drive — no fine print, no gimmicks, just a real cut of a brand people are already obsessed with. Your fans also get 25% off almost everything storewide with your own code.


• How to promote us: Share your link or code anywhere your audience already finds you — Instagram, TikTok, stories, or straight to their DMs. Both are tracked, so however you lead is up to you.


• Other information: Payouts are monthly via bank transfer. Every application and referral gets a quick manual review from our team, so don't worry if there's a short delay before a sale shows up as approved.
payout_period: Payouts will be sent at the end of each month.
